import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('../first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
h,w,_=im.shape
# coarse 48x27 grid, average color, classify
def name(c):
    r,g,b = c
    r,g,b=int(r),int(g),int(b)
    mx,mn=max(r,g,b),min(r,g,b)
    if mx<45: return '.'   # black
    if r>150 and g>130 and b<110 and r>=g: return 'T' # beige/tan table
    if r>150 and g>120 and b<70: return 'Y' # yellow
    if r>120 and g<110 and b<70 and r>g+25: return 'C' # mustard/brown
    if abs(r-g)<25 and abs(g-b)<25: return '#' if mx<110 else '+'
    return '?'
for yy in range(0,h,4):
    row=''
    for xx in range(0,w,4):
        block=im[yy:yy+4,xx:xx+4].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        row+=name(block)
